summary:
FieldShift – Intelligent Agriculture for a Sustainable Future

Smart Agro AI is an intelligent agricultural platform designed to help farmers overcome climate change, water scarcity, extreme weather conditions, and declining soil fertility.

The project combines Artificial Intelligence, NASA satellite data, weather information, and IoT sensors to monitor agricultural land and support smarter farming decisions. Through a Telegram Mini App, farmers can register their fields, monitor soil moisture, temperature, weather conditions, and crop health.

By integrating NASA POWER, satellite vegetation data, and real-time sensor measurements, our system analyzes field conditions, predicts potential crop yields, and provides personalized recommendations for irrigation, crop selection, and crop rotation.

Smart Agro AI also delivers early warnings about drought, extreme temperatures, and other agricultural risks.

Our mission is to transform traditional farming into data-driven, sustainable agriculture, helping farmers save water, improve productivity, reduce losses, and protect natural resources.
details:
Fieldshift

Smart Agro AI is an AI-powered precision agriculture platform that combines satellite observations, IoT technology, meteorological data, and artificial intelligence to help farmers make better agricultural decisions.

How it works:
Farmers use a Telegram Mini App to register their farms and mark their agricultural land on an interactive map. IoT devices equipped with sensors collect information about soil moisture, temperature, humidity, and other soil conditions. The platform combines these measurements with NASA satellite observations and weather data to analyze agricultural conditions.

Key Benefits:

  • Monitors agricultural fields and soil conditions.
  • Analyzes weather patterns and environmental risks.
  • Provides intelligent irrigation recommendations.
  • Monitors vegetation health using satellite data.
  • Predicts crop yields based on available agricultural data.
  • Recommends suitable crops and crop rotation strategies.
  • Sends early warnings about drought, heat, frost, and heavy rainfall.

Innovation and Impact:
Unlike traditional agricultural monitoring systems, Smart Agro AI combines ground-based sensor measurements with large-scale satellite observations and AI analysis. It aims to reduce unnecessary water consumption, minimize crop losses, improve agricultural productivity, and support sustainable farming.

Technology Stack:
Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, PostGIS, Telegram Bot API, Telegram Mini Apps, ESP32/Arduino IoT, NASA POWER API, NASA Earthdata, AI models, and meteorological APIs.

Our long-term vision is to make intelligent, affordable, and sustainable agriculture accessible to farmers, especially in regions facing water scarcity and climate challenges.
